attribution.note: Marcus states this in his own assessment of the contemporary LLM landscape.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the unqualified observation about LLM hallucinations, understood as of the post date.

contract.note: Reading this as the absence of a reliable general solution is ordinary and fair. The period immediately preceding publication fits the ongoing-state observation.

evidence.note: OpenAI's September 2025 disclosure reports persistent GPT-5 hallucinations and an unresolved challenge across LLMs. This is developer testimony, not an independent finding.
The contemporaneous developer disclosure describes hallucinations as still unsolved. It comes from the same source as e1 and adds no independent corroboration.

reviews.rationale: The contemporaneous OpenAI disclosure meets the contract's support criterion: hallucinations persist in its leading model and remain a general challenge. Its reported reduction in hallucinations demonstrates progress but does not establish a robust solution. Both items derive from one company disclosure.
